rationale: Plain Jaccard word-overlap clustering in link-epics --mode synthesize misses thematically-related issues that don't share vocabulary; validated 11 real orphans scored max 0.06 Jaccard, all under threshold. Design: keep Jaccard as a pre-filter, add batched (not per-pair) LLM clustering behind --deep, require cited evidence per cluster.
rule: Captured: --deep flag: LLM-adjudicated clustering for link-epics synthesize mode
